notes: Fixes one real cause of reports landing loose in Downloads. If Chrome restarted the extension in the middle of a run, it forgot which folder the run was using and then built a broken path from the blank - 'Shopee daily report//report.xlsx'. Chrome rejects a path like that without saying so and uses its own name instead, which is where 'download (9).xlsx' came from.

It now waits for the folder to be known instead of guessing, and if it still is not known it says so plainly rather than saving somewhere wrong. This may not be the only cause; if a run still misplaces files, press Copy diagnostics and the report will name the reason.
